children: Tsur David, a Director, reported direct sales of ordinary shares in three transactions on September 7-9, 2026. The transactions comprised 14,238 shares at $8.28, 162,760 shares at $8.26, and 175 shares at $8.26, for a total sale amount of $1,463,733. The weighted average price across the three transactions was approximately $8.26 per share. Following the reported sales, Tsur David directly owned 430,756 ordinary shares of Kamada.
